goal: Prevent deleted private keys and sensitive records from lingering in unallocated database pages
Ensure changing a wallet passphrase cleanly purges superseded encryption keys from disk
agreement: Unaddressed objection: removing VACUUM leaves plaintext keys in existing wallets after encryption (Zippo76)
Verified that secure deletion prevents plaintext key retention across encryption and restarts (fametrano)
Concern that global secure deletion adds unnecessary overhead across all wallet workflows (furszy)

categories.name: wallet
why: P1 because superseded master keys remain recoverable on disk after passphrase changes
Protects users of encrypted wallets from key exposure via unallocated database pages
